verdict.rationale: The pack does not document a user-configurable rules engine in Vanta where a user defines event-based conditions that trigger actions automatically. Webhooks (vanta-docs-4) only push event notifications to an external endpoint, so a developer would have to build the trigger-action logic themselves; that is a building block, not the capability. The marketing mentions of automated reminders, workflows and access approvals describe fixed product automation, not rules the user defines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
